summary: A loop and jump control: when playback reaches it, it jumps to a target position (in ticks, beats or patterns) a set number of times, optionally holding for some ticks first. It makes no sound.
use_for: Jump or loop the song position from a pattern, for live arrangement tricks.
quirks: It acts on playback position, not on sound; a count of 0 means jump without end, so the song then loops until it is stopped.
The count restarts when play is pressed.
Unverified: exactly where in the song the jump is triggered (by its own position in the sequence, as the page says) and how Reset count behaves at zero.
Closed source (a prebuilt DLL): names come from its own texts, its DLL's type names and the profile, not from code.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-14) - a control machine, no sound

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Define how jump target is calculated (Tick, Beat, Pattern)
parameters.how: Chooses the unit of the jump target: Tick, Beat or Pattern (Tick by default).
parameters.sound: It decides whether Target counts ticks, beats or patterns.

parameters.name: Jump
parameters.description: How many times to jump. Resets when play is pressed. If not set or 0 then jump infinitely.
parameters.how: Sets how many times the jump happens, 0 to 2,000; 0 (the default) jumps without end. The count restarts when play is pressed.
parameters.sound: A count gives a limited repeat of a section; 0 loops it for as long as the song plays.

parameters.name: Reset
parameters.how: Chooses whether the jump counter starts again once it reaches zero: No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.sound: Yes lets the loop run again after finishing its count; No lets the song go on.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.how: Sets the position the song jumps to, 0 to 32,767 in the chosen unit (0 by default).
parameters.sound: It sets where the repeat returns to, such as the start of a section.

parameters.name: Hold
parameters.how: Holds playback for this many ticks before the jump, 0 to 20,000 (0 by default).
parameters.sound: A hold lets a section ring on before the song goes back.
